title: Grandfather's Club
setting: A bright club room with many people.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Grandfather
characters.look: Grandfather, an old man with white hair and glasses

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: Maya, a kind woman with long black hair and a green sweater

sentences.en: Ivan's grandfather invites him to his club.
sentences.zh: 伊万的祖父邀请他去自己的俱乐部。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandfather, an old man with white hair and glasses holds the hand of Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt at the door of a bright club room.

sentences.en: His grandfather has friends from many countries.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父有来自许多国家的朋友。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandfather, an old man with white hair and glasses greets a group of friends of different looks in the club room while Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt watches.

sentences.en: Maya is an American woman with a kind face.
sentences.zh: 玛雅是一位面容和善的美国女士。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, a kind woman with long black hair and a green sweater smiles kindly and waves at Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: Her son has a tiger on his shirt.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子穿着一件印着老虎的衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small boy beside Maya, a kind woman with long black hair and a green sweater wears a T-shirt with a big tiger picture.

sentences.en: A Russian man and his wife dance together.
sentences.zh: 一位俄罗斯男士和他的妻子一起跳舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: An older man in a fur hat and his wife dance together in the club room.

sentences.en: A British police officer tells a funny story.
sentences.zh: 一位英国警官讲了一个有趣的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: A police officer in a British-style tall helmet tells a story with big gestures, Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt listening.

sentences.en: Everybody laughs and gives him a big smile.
sentences.zh: 每个人都笑了，并对他露出大大的笑容。
sentences.scene_prompt: Everyone in the club room laughs, Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt, Grandfather, an old man with white hair and glasses and Maya, a kind woman with long black hair and a green sweater smiling at the officer.
